non_numeric_axis_2: unknown components distributed across two point pairs
structural_difference: Extract horizontal displacement from one pair and vertical displacement from the other; recover missing source and image components, rather than transporting a fully given third point.

invariant: collinearity imposes a quadratic; use symmetric root relations
non_numeric_axis_1: one parametrized moving point instead of two separately parametrized vertices
non_numeric_axis_2: separation of feasible points instead of sum of parameters
structural_difference: Recover the fixed line first, impose the quadratic locus, then turn squared root difference into the squared separation along the line.

invariant: ordered reflection composition has period four
non_numeric_axis_1: reverse reconstruction from late observations instead of forward iteration
non_numeric_axis_2: two successive partial observations instead of a complete starting point
structural_difference: Two observed x-components determine different unknown starting components after index offsets; reversing the order alone is not claimed as novelty.

non_numeric_axis_1: given centroid replaces given side length
non_numeric_axis_2: general coordinate triangle and unknown vertex replace regular triangle
structural_difference: Infer the missing vertex from the centroid and obtain full triangle area; alternatively recover the whole area from ABG with known base and centroid height.

invariant: common chord elimination and circle pencil
non_numeric_axis_1: impossible third-point case before possible case
non_numeric_axis_2: center and radius as output instead of two equations
structural_difference: Detect three collinear points as an impossible circle, then reconstruct the circle through the origin and read its center and radius.

invariant: reflection straightens the path; equality determines minimizing point
non_numeric_axis_1: known minimum determines unknown endpoint height
non_numeric_axis_2: minimizer and parameter replace minimum value as target
structural_difference: Use a lower bound with equality, invert the minimum to two height candidates, reject the negative candidate and locate the minimizing point; parts 2 and 3 unchanged.
